name: closeness_centrality
author: 64036f4f
description: Ranks nodes by unweighted closeness centrality, including the standard reachable-fraction correction for disconnected graphs. Use it to find nodes that are few hops from others. Supports directed and undirected graphs and returns top_k node references with six-decimal scores; directed scores use incoming paths.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Number of highest-scoring nodes to return.
